pairs.difference: A: neck pillow covered in an even fabric weave noise with many pinch ridges; the hole's inner edge is ragged and smeared at 2x. B: gold star badge with clean broad bevels and smooth ball tips, one even gloss, no extra marks.
pairs.fix: Smooth matte fabric pillow with a few broad soft folds, no weave texture, clean edge around the opening.

pairs.difference: A: harmonica in brushed silver with a broad soft highlight and two small brass screws, gloss slightly high. B: matte paper fan with flat pleats and plain wooden ribs. Both have real-card material simplification.

A: scout jacket packed with small parts: pocket flaps, a snap button, cuffs, four embossed badges on the sash, a high micro-texture count. B: cowboy hat with smooth matte felt and one wide red band, no stitching, like the real cards.
pairs.fix: Fewer parts: plain jacket with one pocket, sash with two simple flat badges, soft matte cloth, no buttons or small trims.

pairs.difference: A: caravan full of small hardware: roof vent slats, door frame trim, a knob, a side lamp, a hitch box, a jack stand, wheel hubs. B: buoy built from a few broad smooth red cylinders and a simple gold bell, as in the real cards.
pairs.fix: Simplify the caravan into broad smooth body panels and one wide stripe, drop the vents, lamps and hitch hardware.

pairs.difference: B: cowboy boots with dashed stitch lines over the shaft and toe, decorative inlay, rivets and a spur with a spiked rowel, small crisp detail like the generated glove in the lessons. A: sneakers with a broad mesh area and simple laces, mostly smooth plastic.
pairs.fix: Smooth leather boots with a soft sheen, a single simple solid inlay curve, no dashed stitching, the spur as one smooth band.

pairs.difference: A: glossy, waxy green cactus ribs with no spines. B: glossy toy plastic duck on a metal spring. Both are one-material toy gloss, which matches the real cards' finish; neither one stands out.
A: soft satin bandana with flat dots and a broad sheen. B: matte navy cap board with crisp, clean corners and a simple tassel. Both match the real cards' broad smooth surfaces.

B: saddle with a fine leather pore grain, dashed yellow stitch lines around every edge, and metal buckles and bolt caps on the strap, the stitching-and-hardware addition seen in the generated lessons. A: boxing gloves with a soft broad red gloss, a few crease lines, and a quiet wood-grain table.
pairs.fix: Smooth leather saddle with a soft sheen, no dashed stitching or pore texture, the strap as one plain wide band with no bolts.

pairs.difference: B: wagon with rivet dots on the box corners, bolted hubs, a stitched seam on the canvas, and pebble specks on the ground, with highlight share above the real range. A: rocking chair with simple shapes and a quiet wood grain.
pairs.fix: Plain wooden wagon box with no rivets, simple wheel hubs, a smooth canvas cover with no seams.

pairs.difference: B is the real lighthouse from the lessons: smooth red rail, soft bricks. A: windmill tower painted with scratch and crack marks plus a dense straw-grass texture, and a highlight share of 0.29, above the real range.
pairs.fix: Smooth painted tower with clean flat faces and no cracks or scratches, simple soft field with no individual grass strokes.

pairs.difference: A: campfire logs with large decorative end-grain rings and bark streaks, painterly flame and ember specks, a flat illustrated background. B: viewer in one smooth brushed blue metal with broad bands and a simple coin slot.
pairs.fix: Smooth logs with a quiet surface and simple end caps, no grain rings, clean flame shapes.

pairs.difference: A: phone booth with many thin glazing bars, a tiny keypad, a cord and a handle, with smeared edges on the keypad at 2x. B: trophy in one smooth gold with broad soft highlights and simple handles.
pairs.fix: Fewer, wider window bars, the phone as a simple dark shape behind the glass, smooth red paint with no small hardware.

pattern: The generated cards add small hardware and fine detail that the real cards leave out: dashed stitch lines, rivets and bolts, buckles, vents, keypads, and scratch or crack marks. They also put fabric or pore noise and big decorative wood grain on surfaces that the real cards keep as broad, smooth, softly lit planes.
